  when "Set up GBrain", first boot, `skills/setup/SKILL.md`
  when "Now what?", "fill my brain", "cold start", "bootstrap", "import my data", "what should I import first", `skills/cold-start/SKILL.md`

  when "Extract links", "build link graph", "populate timeline", `skills/maintain/SKILL.md` (extraction sections)
  when "Run dream", "process today's session", "synthesize my conversations", "consolidate yesterday's conversations", "what patterns did you see", "did the dream cycle run", `skills/maintain/SKILL.md` (dream cycle section)
  when "Brain health", "what features am I missing", "brain score", Run `gbrain features --json`
  when "Set up autopilot", "run brain maintenance", "keep brain updated", Run `gbrain autopilot --install --repo ~/brain`
  when "Upgrade gbrain", "update gbrain", "gbrain update available", `UPGRADE_AVAILABLE`, "is gbrain up to date", `skills/gbrain-upgrade/SKILL.md`
  when Agent identity, "who am I", customize agent, `skills/soul-audit/SKILL.md`
  when "Populate links", "extract links", "backfill graph", `skills/maintain/SKILL.md` (graph population phase)
  when "Populate timeline", "extract timeline entries", `skills/maintain/SKILL.md` (graph population phase)
